source_evidence: To bring your portfolio back to its original asset allocation, you may need to rebalance your portfolio.
question: Misconception: If one asset class has grown faster than the others, you should keep its larger share rather than rebalance your portfolio.
answer: A faster-growing asset class can push your portfolio away from its original allocation and change its risk level. Rebalancing can bring the mix back toward that allocation, which may involve selling some of the faster-growing investment and/or adding money to other asset categories.
